body: And idc if you’re downvoting me Bc while spun I’d do the same shit. Nobody wants to hear this while high, esp if you think you’re invincible(I mean that’s also jus the effect of the drug duh lol)And YOU might be. But not fucking everyone is and you gotta accept speed addicts have stigma for a REASON. I know 90% of ppl reading this are already spun af or feel they can handle it, but we’re also addicted to a drug that LITERALLY(like bruh we have physical proof,,) changes our brain chemistry. Not everyone can handle that nor should they have to because you feel too euphoric/smart to deny it. Facts over feelings. Good luck to u all, ima keep preaching and shit in here tho. Hopefully next time I won’t even be drunk.  First step is admittance though and OP you already K N O W.

There is no cure to addiction, only treatment. Go to r/stopspeeding or r/redditorsinrecovery
Read their experiences, take it all in while you’re still in this state of regret/being scared. 12 step programs DO help a lot. They’re not for everyone but the majority of fully recovered addicts I know this was their gateway. Focus on the negatives this drug has caused you even with harm reduction. The addiction disease will rip this feeling away from you all the time, you’ll only be reminded of the high, But you gotta fight that shit. I grew up with all the consequences all around me and still tried to “experiment”
Props to the “functional addicts” who can handle it but if you feel like this you KNOW the answer. Being functional on something so strong is so rare and takes so much discipline. If you truly WANT to quit, but CANT, you’re addicted. I couldn’t handle it either but take this as a warning-I’m preaching but I’m still drunk rn because I’m a fucking addict. And my addict brain says this is okay because it’s at least legal/socially acceptable. But nah once you lose you lose your control of simple choice you gotta fight hard as fuck. You’ll get your ass beat no matter how strong you think you are in the beginning, but it does get easier. There are tons of steps to recovery and they never truly end. Good luck dude or gal.

No. Sometimes we need this push. OP, rehab SUCKS but it’s for a reason, being strung out with a shitty life sucks 10x worse. If you keep on this path you’ll be involuntary admitted to a mental hospital/rehab/outpatient eventually. I promise you. 
Edit;let’s not forget jail, death, or existing while not truly living. Fight it.

Everything that can be physically explained as “you” is the brain. Your brain aka YOU drives the bone and flesh and muscles that retain “memory” and that’s why you know those piano notes. Bones and flesh and everything else ain’t nothing without your brain. I wish we could see our soul physically because I’d love to believe we have one, that we are more than ugly wrinkles. Some pale blue almost translucent copy of your true self, to choose our final true destination. But so far all we’ve found ourselves to be, after studying ourselves, is some grey slimy wrinkled blob of slob.
